input_field.description: Exact observed String/discrete or numeric/continuous predictor name.

target_field.description: Exact discrete string binary target name, different from input_field; assign output role. Training requires two nonmissing labels.

event_value.description: Exact target label defining the event; must occur in training. WoE uses ln(non-event share/event share).

partition.description: Automatic, manually edited native classes, or native external input 1; no variables.

min_class_percent.description: Minimum class weight in percent, not a fraction; acceptance uses 5.

max_classes.description: Upper limit on classes, not a promised exact count; acceptance uses 2.

uniformity_percent.description: UI uniformity percentage; 0 maximizes IV, 100 favors equal class weights. Acceptance uses 0.

frozen.description: Freeze materialized partition; execution/apply must not silently recompute boundaries.

classes.description: Proposal only: native manual class edits, exact categories or numeric bounds.

label.description: Desired manual class label, subject to native editor confirmation.

values.description: Exact discrete category members; NULL differs from empty string.

oneOf.description: Civil ISO YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sss, without timezone conversion.

lower.description: Exact numeric lower bound for a continuous class.

oneOf.description: Civil ISO YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sss, without timezone conversion.

upper.description: Exact numeric upper bound for a continuous class.

coarse_classes.description: Proposal: existing discrete training/apply plus continuous/external/manual/frozen classes. Unknown/NULL categories and zero-frequency behavior require observed native evidence.
